sloka: तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे ।देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता ।पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः ।। ७.२६.५८ ॥
transliteration: tasminnudāhṛte śāpe jvalitāgnisamaprabhe ।devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca khāccyutā ।pitāmahamukhāścaiva sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ ।। 7.26.58 ॥

translations.english: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.
